purpose: A long posting whose requirements live in two prose paragraphs, surrounded by company history, values, a team description, benefits, hiring process and equal-opportunity text. Tests that boilerplate is not extracted and that prose requirements are, including a work-authorization condition stated in the legal paragraph and a 'would help but is not essential' item without a heading.

requirements.why: POSTING COUNT: team lead experience; English and Spanish; Zendesk or comparable; workforce scheduling and QA scorecards; authorised to work in Ireland. The last two are contested or splittable, hence the range.
'would help but is not essential' is the posting's own framing of a preferred item.
